blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan, in his appearance before Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro on Monday, protested against the remarks of government officials and lawmakers that supposedly take him “out of context.” The Chinese embassy in Manila, in a statement, detailed Jing’s exchange with Lazaro after the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) summoned him over what it described as “provocative and unacceptable” remarks. “On Oct. 19, 2026, Ambassador Jing Quan met with Philippine Foreign Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro at [her] request, making strong demarches over the recent remarks of Philippine officials and politicians which take […]...
